prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop hospitality homepage concept, 1440px-wide landscape canvas, rendered edge to edge with no browser or device frame.
Input images: Image 1 is the exact resort logo and identity reference; Image 2 is the resort's real living-room photograph; Image 3 is the resort's real aerial amenity photograph; Image 4 is a real apartment bedroom. Use these as fixed factual brand/property imagery inside the interface. Preserve the logo silhouette and the recognizable rooms; do not invent different architecture.
Primary request: Direction A — Modern Editorial Luxury for ‘The 12 by Naji Resort’. Create a polished real website comp whose first viewport feels like a contemporary hospitality journal, not a template. Let one generous living-room photograph occupy most of the canvas while an ivory editorial band cuts across it and carries the content. Set a large, refined high-contrast editorial headline with disciplined line breaks: ‘Where Resort Amenities Meet Residential Elegance.’ Include the supporting line ‘Redefining Resort Living.’
Frame: minimal top navigation with the resort mark/name, Rooms, Gallery, Tours, Events, Contact, and a clear ‘Book Now’ action. Integrate a functional booking strip into the lower edge of the first viewport with ‘Check in’, ‘Check out’, ‘Apartment’, and ‘View apartments’. Show the start of the next section with ‘The Apartment Resort’ and one restrained glimpse of the aerial photograph.
Visual law: warm parchment #F5F0E7, ink #1C1915, clean white #FFFFFF, brand gold #C89A3D. Editorial serif display character paired with a quiet modern sans. Fine rules, sharp corners, no cards, no pills, no glass, no gradients, no shadows.
Constraints: crisp readable UI text, generous whitespace, one dominant move, practical navigation and booking controls, no prices, ratings, awards, people, extra logos, stock imagery, or invented claims.
